products.name_en: DJI Pocket 3 - Pocket-Sized Gimbal Camera with 1-Inch Sensor
products.name_ar: DJI Pocket 3 - Pocket-Sized Gimbal Camera with 1-Inch Sensor
products.short_desc_en: Pocket-sized handheld camera with 3-axis mechanical gimbal and 1-inch CMOS sensor. 4K/120fps recording with a rotatable 2-inch touchscreen. The world's smallest 1-inch sensor gimbal camera.
products.desc_ar:
A cinematic studio in your pocket.

The **DJI Pocket 3** combines a large 1-inch sensor with a 3-axis mechanical gimbal in a device the size of a marker. The result: limitless cinematic stabilized video wherever you go.

**Why This Product?**
- **1-Inch Sensor:** Stunning low-light performance with natural depth of field.
- **3-Axis Gimbal:** True mechanical stabilization for silk-smooth footage.
- **4K/120fps:** Cinematic slow-motion at the highest resolution.
- **Rotatable 2" Screen:** Rotates for vertical (social media) or horizontal shooting.
- **Triple Microphone:** High-quality stereo audio with wind noise reduction.
- **ActiveTrack 6.0:** Precision intelligent subject tracking.

**Technical Specifications:**
| Sensor | 1" CMOS |
|---|---|
| Video | 4K/120fps, 4K HDR |
| Photos | 40 MP |
| Gimbal | 3-axis mechanical |
| Display | 2" OLED rotatable touchscreen |
| Battery | 1300mAh (up to 166 minutes) |
| Connectivity | Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.2 |
| Storage | microSD up to 512GB |
| Dimensions | 139.7 × 42.2 × 33.5 mm |
| Weight | 179 g |

products.name_en: Roborock S8 MaxV Ultra - Smart Robot Vacuum with 10,000Pa Suction
products.name_ar: Roborock S8 MaxV Ultra - Smart Robot Vacuum with 10,000Pa Suction
products.short_desc_en: Robot vacuum and mop with 10,000Pa suction power. Self-maintaining dock washes, dries, refills water, and empties dust automatically. AI camera obstacle avoidance. Home Assistant compatible.
products.desc_ar:
Your home's cleanliness on autopilot.

The **Roborock S8 MaxV Ultra** is the most powerful and intelligent robot cleaner in the world. With 10,000Pa suction and a fully self-maintaining dock, all you need to do is sit back and relax.

**Why This Product?**
- **10,000Pa Suction:** Strongest in class, cleans deep carpets and hard floors.
- **Fully Self-Maintaining Dock:** Hot water mop washing (60°C), drying, clean water refill, and dust emptying.
- **Auto-Lifting Mop:** Raises 20mm when transitioning to carpet to prevent wetting.
- **ReactiveAI 2.0 Camera:** Recognizes 73+ obstacle types (shoes, cables, toys) and avoids them.
- **LiDAR + Camera:** Precise 3D mapping of your home.
- **Smart Control:** Roborock app + Alexa, Google Home, and Home Assistant support.

**Technical Specifications:**
| Suction Power | 10,000 Pa |
|---|---|
| Battery | 5200mAh (up to 180 minutes) |
| Navigation | LiDAR + ReactiveAI 2.0 Camera |
| Mop | Dual rotating + 20mm auto-lift |
| Dock | Hot wash + dry + water refill + dust empty |
| Dustbin Capacity | 350ml (robot) + 2.5L (dock) |
| Water Tank | 200ml (robot) + 4L (dock) |
| Noise Level | 67 dB (balanced mode) |
| Dimensions | 353 × 353 × 96.5 mm |
| Weight | 4.65 kg (robot only) |
